title: Agent media pack manifest
summary: JSON Schema for an agent-ready media pack: assets with source URL, licence, licence URL, exact credit, redistribution, sha256 once fetched, format and Godot/Blender/video import hints.
description: Manifests point at sources and never contain media. Rules enforced by the schema: CC-BY/OGA-BY entries must require attribution and carry a credit line; fetched entries need sha256, bytes and file_name; direct fetches need an https download_url; assets whose redistribution is forbidden cannot be fetched directly. The space/NASA example records real SHA-256 values measured on 2026-10-10.
